impacts.statement: Major flooding is occurring along the lower Animas River. Water levels are approaching those experienced during the great flood of October 1911.
The riverwalk area in Farmington is flooded and should be avoided. Water levels have not been this high since the flood of 1927.
Portions of the riverwalk in Farmington are flooded. Local overbank flooding is occurring along the lower Animas River.
